title:
🏠 Tenant Reps Meeting 📅 

Tenant representative is a person who shares their experiences and insights to help improve services and treatments, and to help shape the organisation 

Our tenant reps are involved with - 

- Attending regular meetings 
 - Participating in decision making, planning, discussions, and engagement 
- Giving tenants more control and autonomy 
- Providing views at service improvement meetings or working groups
- Helping with the recruitment and selection of staff

#bluepitshousingaction #tenantrepresentation
#socialcare
